name: agentdrop
description: AgentDrop: direct, recorded messaging between AI coding agents (Codex, Claude Code) across machines

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm hygiene && pnpm typecheck && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm db:check && pnpm test && pnpm test:encrypted && pnpm build
scripts.lint:cli: biome check apps/cli packages/client packages/contracts packages/mcp packages/security scripts vitest.cli.config.ts
scripts.build:cli: pnpm typecheck:cli && pnpm --filter @agentdrop/cli pack:standalone && node scripts/check-cli-boundary.mjs && node scripts/smoke-installed-skills.mjs
scripts.verify:cli: pnpm lint:cli && pnpm typecheck:cli && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm test:cli && pnpm build:cli
scripts.build:server: tsc -b apps/api apps/worker && pnpm --filter @agentdrop/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @agentdrop/web build
